is_anopheles.evidence: Study conducted on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s. M and S forms, and An. arabiensis) collected in The Gambia (Page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped kdr 1014 (1014F and 1014S, corresponding to Vgsc L995F and L995S) in An. gambiae s.l. (Page 2-4, Table 1).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 (Page 4) reports full counts of 1014 genotypes (LL, LS, LF, SF, FF, SS) for An. arabiensis, An. gambiae M form, and An. gambiae S form across two villages (Sare Alpha and Sare Juldeh).

african_field_population.evidence: Immature and adult Anopheles gambiae s.l. were collected from August to November 2011 in Sare Alpha and Sare Juldeh, Upper River Region, The Gambia (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical field trial evaluating IRS and vector insecticide resistance in The Gambia.

sub_country_location.evidence: Sare Alpha village (13°21' 38 N, 13°58' 50 W) and Sare Juldeh village (13°19' 32 N, 14°3' 36 W), Upper River Region, The Gambia (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected between August and November 2011 (Page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine primary field study and IRS evaluation in The Gambia with original collections in 2011.

supplement.evidence: All required genotype counts by species and location are fully present in Table 1 of the main article text.

assessment.summary: This primary field study evaluated insecticide resistance, kdr frequencies (Vgsc 1014F and 1014S), and IRS efficacy in Sare Alpha and Sare Juldeh, Upper River Region, The Gambia in 2011. Table 1 provides extractable 1014 genotype counts (LL, LS, LF, SF, FF, SS) for An. arabiensis, An. gambiae M form (An. coluzzii), and An. gambiae S form (An. gambiae s.s.).
